fields.description: Issue includes investigative commentary alleging a Miami-area bankruptcy "ring" involving referee L. Earl Curry, receiver L. M. Gerstel, and Joe Morris, with discussion of the Miami Beach Gas Company/People's Gas Company case and other bankruptcies. Editorial content criticizes city officials (including Recreation Director Ernie Seiler) and discusses budget-revenue ideas. Features a traffic-safety campaign noting high automobile-accident deaths and urging brake testing and obeying traffic laws, plus local columns ("Round the Town," "Rambles and Rumbles"), horse-racing tips by "Jockey Jimmy," and coverage of Miami Life's working-girl beauty contest (winner: Mary Buckley, courthouse telephone operator).
